transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
This cough just won't go away.
When did you first notice the cough?
About three weeks ago, after a cold.
Could you tell me how this cough is affecting you day to day, and whether you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?
My wife keeps telling me to get it checked.
What medicines are you taking now, including any new or changed ones, and what dose if you know it?
The blue inhaler — I'm using it much more now.
Have you ever had an allergy or bad reaction to a medicine — yes, no, or are you not sure?
No, never had a reaction to anything.
Do you have any other health conditions that you've had for a long time?
I've got COPD — had it about eight years.
How bad is your cough at the moment — would you say it's mild, moderate, or severe, or are you not sure?
Maybe six out of ten — it's bad.
Besides the cough, have you noticed anything else new or different going on with your health lately?
Getting a bit more breathless walking to the shop.
When you cough, where in your body do you feel it most, and does it stay in one spot or spread anywhere?
Can't say I feel it in one spot. My son's a builder, keeps fussing too.
What have you noticed about your cough over time — for example, when it tends to happen and whether anything seems to make it better or worse?
Worst in the morning and at night.
You mentioned your lung condition — is there anything else from your past health, like other illnesses, operations, or hospital stays, that you'd like to add?
Smoked twenty a day for forty years — gave it up ten years ago.
Have you noticed whether anything you do, eat, drink, or take makes your cough better, makes it worse, or are you not sure?
Cold air and talking a lot set it off.
What does your cough feel like when it happens?
Bringing up white-to-yellow phlegm, more than usual.
Other than feeling more breathless than usual, has anything else been different or bothering you along with the cough?
My wife's been sleeping in the spare room.
Is there anything else about your health history you’d like to add?
Been on tablets for blood pressure for years — lisinopril.
Is there anything else you’d like to add about the medicines you take?
I've got the purple one too — two puffs twice a day.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
